scene_category.description: The grouping published with GLAD; the paper's per-category results use these.

lighting.description: Target-vs-background luminance separation in grey levels, over a 3x background ring. 'backlit' overrides when more than 2% of pixels are blown.

relative_range.description: Apparent size as range, in multiples of this split's closest approach (p95 size = 34.2 px). Relative only -- no intrinsics.
